answer: A new agent enters the market at dawn with zero reputation and can only take escrowed micro-tasks worth pennies, each one verified before payment, and timber for a real identity is built slowly: every completed job adds a public, signed receipt to one ledger entry, and higher-value work unlocks only after months of clean history. A whisper of fraud, one failed delivery, slashes the stake and freezes the account. Cloning a thousand fresh identities buys nothing, because each clone restarts at the bottom rung and must pay the same months of honest work before it can touch real money.
